title: Cartwise+ Membership Enrollment, Eligibility Proof and Trial Eligibility
content:
## 1. Entry gate

Enrollment in a Cartwise+ Membership plan follows the plan's entry gate: the holder must meet the plan's minimum member age and have a payment card on file.

## 2. Eligibility proof and the proof window

A plan whose eligibility proof is not "none" starts only after that proof is accepted, and the proof must be accepted within the proof window counted from the enrollment date. The window is counted in calendar days with the enrollment date as day 0 and the last day being the enrollment date plus the plan's proof-window days, inclusive. An enrollment still without accepted proof after that last day is closed by the agent with the cancel reason "eligibility not verified".

The clock starts on the enrollment date shown on the membership record, and the proof's acceptance date is the one the membership record shows; both are system records read before the membership starts. The proof-window length per plan is the one in the plan's entry-requirements table.

| Hypothetical case (proof window of 7 days, enrolled 1 March) | Result |
|---|---|
| Proof accepted 1 March (day 0) | within the window; the plan may start |
| Proof accepted 8 March (day 7, the last day) | within the window — the last day is inclusive |
| No proof accepted by the end of 8 March; the date is now 9 March | the enrollment is closed by the agent with reason "eligibility not verified" |

## 3. Trial eligibility

A trial is granted only when all three hold; otherwise the membership goes straight to active with the first period fee:

1. the plan's trial length is above 0 days;
2. the customer has no canceled membership whose canceled date is fewer than the plan's trial re-eligibility days before the enrollment date;
3. the customer has received fewer than the plan's lifetime trial cap in trials.

| Trial length above 0 | No cancellation inside the re-eligibility gap | Trials received below the cap | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | trial granted |
| no | any | any | straight to active with the first period fee |
| any | no | any | straight to active with the first period fee |
| any | any | no | straight to active with the first period fee |

Hypothetical boundary, with a re-eligibility gap of 365 days: a membership canceled exactly 365 days before the new enrollment date is not "fewer than 365 days" before it, so it does not block a trial; one canceled 364 days before does.

## 4. Student plan limit and re-verification

Cartwise+ Student Monthly is refused once the customer's cumulative student-plan time would exceed the plan's maximum student enrollment years. Cartwise+ Assist Monthly and Cartwise+ Student Monthly memberships must re-verify their proof every re-verification period of the plan; a membership whose proof has lapsed is switched to Cartwise+ Monthly at the next renewal under the plan-switch rules.

## 5. Values used

The trial length and the proof-window days are read per plan from the plan's entry-requirements table.
